end

methods.name: simtalkcode
methods.program:
var o: object := str_to_obj(\".SimtalkClaude.main.SimtalkAction.simtalkcode\")
print \"###PROBE_BEGIN###\
if o = void
  print \"VOID=true\
  print \"PATH=.SimtalkClaude.main.SimtalkAction.simtalkcode\
else
  print \"NAME=\" + o.Name
  print \"TYPE=\" + o.InternalClassType
  print \"ENCRYPTED=\" + to_str(o.Encrypted)
  print \"SYNTAX_ERROR=\" + to_str(o.HasSyntaxError)
  print \"NUM_IN_EXECUTION=\" + to_str(o.NumInExecution)
  print \"###PROBE_BODY###\
  if o.Encrypted
    print \"<encrypted>\
  else
    print o.Program
  end
  print \"###PROBE_END###\
end
